integrity.experimental_scope: exact enumeration through nine vertices is corroboration, not proof
integrity.proof_basis: bijective root-leaf deletion, Eulerian recurrence and bounded 1-dependent central limit theorem

scientific_limitations: Uniform recursive trees with independent uniform attachment only; not preferential or plane-oriented recursive trees.
No assertion of an analogous bivariate law for other rooted-tree models.
Historical priority remains provisional because general increasing-tree enumerators might indirectly encode this specialization.
title: Exact joint leaf law at the root of a uniform recursive tree
